prompt: A black-and-white typography poster in portrait format, bold distressed artwork on a solid black background. Four lines of white lettering are stacked in one tight block of nearly equal width in the center of the poster, with moderate black margins around it, and the whole block tilts slightly so each line rises toward the right. At the top, the word "FEWER" is written in large heavy condensed bold sans-serif capitals. Directly beneath it, the word "EXCUSES" is written in huge heavy condensed bold sans-serif capitals. Below it, the word "BIGGER" is written in the same heavy condensed sans-serif capitals as the top line. At the bottom, the word "MOVES" is written in the same heavy condensed sans-serif capitals. The lines sit close together. The first and last lines are the tallest. The poster shows only these four words, each of them once, in pure white and black with no gray, no outline, no shadow, no ornaments, and nothing below the last line.
